description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the ProjectActivityDao class within the OrangeHRM time plugin. It tests CRUD operations, filtering, duplication checks, and copying activities related to project management.

classes.name: ProjectActivityDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing ProjectActivityDao methods related to project activities management.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of ProjectActivityDao, and populates test data from a fixture YAML file.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivityList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of project activity list by project ID.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivityListByFilterProjectActivityName
methods.description: Tests filtering project activities by name within a project.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivityById
methods.description: Tests fetching a specific project activity by project ID and activity ID.

methods.name: testSaveProjectActivity
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new project activity.

methods.name: testEditProjectActivity
methods.description: Tests editing an existing project activity.

methods.name: testExceptionForDeleteProjectActivity
methods.description: Verifies exception handling when deleting project activities.

methods.name: testDeleteProjectActivity
methods.description: Tests successful deletion of a project activity.

methods.name: testDeleteProjectActivityNameValidation
methods.description: Tests validation logic for project activity name uniqueness.

methods.name: testGetDuplicatedActivityIds
methods.description: Checks retrieval of duplicated project activities.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivitiesByProjectIds
methods.description: Tests fetching multiple project activities by their IDs.

methods.name: testSaveCopyActivity
methods.description: Tests copying activities from one project to another.
